P-15f8 is in good shape. Here's the outcome.

## What I found

The prior (idle) P-15f8 session had **already proved the entire thing** and committed it — but left it **orphaned**: `GQ2/DimClose.lean` and `GQ2/ResidueLift.lean` were sorry-free and committed, yet **not imported from `GQ2.lean`**, so the assembly of `lemma_6_17_dim` wasn't even in the library build (invisible to CI, prone to silent bitrot).

`ResidueLift.lemma_6_17_dim_final` proves `#X₊² = #H¹(ℚ₂,V)` from **exactly** `lemma_6_17_dim`'s own hypotheses — genuinely unconditional:
- the `[Finite (H¹(ker ρ,𝔽₂))]` instance is discharged internally (`finite_H1_open`, since `ker ρ` is open);
- the one "arithmetic input" — a residue-trivial lift of tame inertia — is **proved from the existing budget**: the tame relation `σ⁻¹τσ = τ²` makes `τ` a commutator, and commutators are residue-trivial via Teichmüller approximation (`exists_rootOfUnity_near`, off the B13 filtration) + commuting Galois action on roots of unity. No residue-field machinery, no new axiom.

## What I did

1. **Registered** `DimClose` + `ResidueLift` in [GQ2.lean](GQ2.lean) — the proof is now part of the build.
2. **Verified**: `lake build GQ2.ResidueLift` green (8654 jobs); `#print axioms lemma_6_17_dim_final` = **std-3 + {B6, B7, B11a, B12, B13}** — the §6.3 deep-part budget, **no new axiom**.
3. **Committed** ([ae8fd55](GQ2.lean)) just the 2-line import registration, staged as an index blob so the concurrent swarm edits to `GQ2.lean` stay intact. Board row + splice recipe recorded in [tickets.md](docs/tickets.md).

## What remains — and why I stopped here

Only the **statement-move splice** is left: closing the `SectionSix.lemma_6_17_dim` sorry (873). Its sole consumer `DeepPart.prop_6_18_ramified` calls **both** SectionSix sorries (dim + vanish) and sits *upstream* of both downstream proofs, so the move relocates `prop_6_18_ramified` to a new leaf importing `ResidueLift` (dim) **and** f2d's `VanishClose` (vanish).

That's **co-owned with the active P-15f2d agent** — `GQ2/VanishClose.lean` is in the tree but only has wiring bricks so far, not the vanish-final. Doing the SectionSix/`prop_6_18` edit now would collide head-on and can't even typecheck (no downstream vanish proof yet). So the dim proof is staged and ready; the joint move should happen once f2d's vanish lands. I've left the exact recipe on the board and did **not** touch SectionSix.

**Net:** P-15f8's mathematics is done, verified, and now actually in the build; `lemma_6_17_dim` collapses to a one-shot splice that's gated on f2d. Want me to pick up one of the P-16 residue bricks (e3 or e4a) while that unblocks, or prepare the joint splice leaf as a skeleton so it's ready the moment f2d's vanish proof lands?

**(2) is done and committed** ([9529636](GQ2/InvolutionSplice.lean)) — and with a better outcome than scoped. Summary:

## The headline: the feared bridge doesn't exist — because it isn't needed

The "Evens-norm cohomology-invariance bridge" I'd flagged as the last genuine §6.3 mathematics (~50–100 lines of degree-2 coboundary analysis) **dissolved on a fresh look**: with trivial coefficients, `B¹ = 0` (`B1_eq_bot_of_trivial`, banked), so *cohomologous scalar cocycles are equal as functions*. `eq_of_H1ofFun_eq` extracts from the deep-class witness a square root `β` with `kummerCocycleFun β = α_j` **on the nose** — the two candidate inner cochains coincide, and `evensNormFun` never needs to descend to cohomology.

## What landed — [GQ2/InvolutionSplice.lean](GQ2/InvolutionSplice.lean) (new, ~430 lines)

**`hvanish_involution_ker`** — the reducer's involution `hvanish` in `ker ρ`/`U₀`-vocabulary, matching f2c1's `hcoh_involution` inner **verbatim**. The chain:
- **B¹=0 extraction** → the Kummer cocycle *is* the block coordinate
- **The tower** `k = fixedField(toGal U₀) ≤ L = splitField ρ` — `toGal` extends the `kerGal` idiom to overgroups; correspondence + finiteness from `InfiniteGalois`
- **Index-2 in both Galois-group views** (coset decomposition of `N ⊔ ⟨ĝ⟩`; all cross-view steps closed by default-transparency `rfl`-bridges)
- **c2a + c2c + c2b** consumed as-is: `kummer_presentation_of_index_two`, `hunram_involution` (with `R`/`horient` threaded per the c2c4 consumer note — P-20 flag), `hvanish_involution` (= Lemma 6.16)
- **The carrier splice**: since `evensAux`/`bS` are `Quotient.out`-free, the `↥U₀ ↔ ↥k.fixingSubgroup` Evens cochains agree pointwise (`evensNormFun_comp`), and the `B²`-witness pulls back along the underlying-identity hom (`H2ofFun_eq_zero_comp`)

**Verified**: `#print axioms` = std-3 + {B9, B11a, B11b, B13} **exactly** (no B5 — `R` stays parametric); six general bricks pure std-3; `lake build` green (8665); `check_axioms` all-pass, census 15. Handoff [§3a rewritten](docs/p15f2d-handoff.md) and board row updated.

## P-15f2d remaining

Both `hvanish` inputs now have landed producers (square/free = `hvanish_cup` + splitField transport; involution = this). What's left is genuinely mechanical:
1. **The reducer application** — the per-orbit case-split feeding `hcoh` (f2c1) + `hvanish` into `Q0loc_vanish_of_datum_decomp`, completing `lemma_6_17_vanish_of_deepData`'s sorried back half (the verified front-half is in the handoff).
2. **The statement-move** — joint with the landed P-15f8 dim proof: relocate `prop_6_18_ramified`, clear both SectionSix sorries.

Shall I continue with the reducer application? That's the last substantive build before the two-sorry endgame splice.

The family handoff is written and committed: **[docs/p16d6e4aAP-handoff.md](docs/p16d6e4aAP-handoff.md)** ([3112e2a]), with a rescope pointer added to the P5 board row ([8e9259a]) so nobody starts P5 against the refuted package route.

The document is the self-contained map of the whole P1–P5 endgame:

- **The stakes, stated precisely**: the family closes the last **two live `sorry` tokens in the entire library** — the P3 count at [GaussZFinalGammaA.lean:1252](~/claude/gq2-lean/GQ2/GaussZFinalGammaA.lean:1252) and the G0-obtain at [ThmFourTwo.lean:290](~/claude/gq2-lean/GQ2/ThmFourTwo.lean:290) — with the close cascade running through `thm_4_2` → `main_surjection_count'` → the whole formalization at std-3 + the frozen 15-axiom census. (I verified this by census: the other allowlist entries are comment-mentions only.)
- **Status table**: P1 downgraded (fallback only), P2 closed, P3 in flight with its four landed increments and next steps, P4 closed with the refutation, P4b/P4c landed, P4d/P4e open, P5 rescoped.
- **The architecture change**, front and center: why the original `TamePackage` plan is impossible, what head-inflation replaces it with, and the explicit warning that `gaussZ_obtain_of_tamePackage*` is superseded.
- **Consumer-facing inventory** of everything P4b/P4c landed (names, hypothesis shapes, axiom footprints), the **work order** for P4d → P4e → P5 with the P5 edit spec, the **single P3↔P4d interface** (cite `zeroCount_qDouble_ramified_of_faithful`, never fork it), and the banked instance-spelling gotchas.
- One **correction** to my earlier P4d handoff, called out explicitly: citing the sorried count interface adds no `sorry` token, so the P4d leaf needs no allowlist entry.

Everything is committed clean; the working tree has no leftover changes, and P3's agent's parallel commits are untouched.
